dialogue.speaker: MAYA
dialogue.text: Pancakes, just as promised.

dialogue.text: Of course. I know just the thing.

dialogue.text: Why are you looking over there?

dialogue.text: Would breakfast need a flowerpot too?

dialogue.text: Ah. The pancakes are not requesting a centerpiece.

dialogue.text: So not just any spoon?

dialogue.text: Exactly. These help us use the right amount.

dialogue.text: Just a little careful preparation.
